senses.gloss: m. (cmp. חֲרִיקָא, a. Arab. ḫaraġ) capitation tax, tax, tribute.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:1">Targ. Lam. I, 1</cite>; a. e.—
B. Bath. 55ᵃ כ׳ אקרקף וכ׳ karga rests on the head of man, i.e. is a personal liability, opp. to טַסְקָא.
Ib. אפי׳ … משתעבדי לכ׳ even the barley in the pot is seizable for k.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73b:7">B. Mets. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>דיהבי זוזי אַכַּ׳ דאינשי וכ׳</he> who pay the taxes for other people and force them to unreasonable services.
